A SERVES toward an application domain layered over an accepted family edge is a redundant use-claim dressed as purpose.

A technique does not serve the discipline that contains it. audio-engineering's accepted definition lists spatialization among its OWN parameters — it is a component of that practice, not a servant of it. SERVES runs servant to master (for whose sake built): spatialization is built for the sake of producing spatial perception in audio works, not for the discipline qua discipline. Its family relation is already carved correctly: spatialization INSTANCE_OF audio-processing is ACCEPTED. Category conflation: the membership relation (instance of the processing family) is re-labeled as service of the containing discipline.

The note's own argument is an argument about input supply, not filter operation: 'without the clock no samples arrive'. But the biquad's mechanism — the difference equation over two delay elements — operates on a sample SEQUENCE, and reads no clock. Offline batch rendering, a first-class mode of digital audio operation, runs biquad sections over pre-existing sample arrays with no sample clock running; remove the clock and the construct still operates, so the removal test fails cleanly. sample-clock's accepted definition carves it as the capture/reconstruction stage's timing reference ('the instants at which an ADC or DAC captures or reconstructs samples') — upstream of the filter. The constitutive operational dependency is on the sample sequence (the accepted entry audio-sample), not the clock that stamped those samples. If the biquad depended on the clock it would equally depend on the microphone, the ADC, and the DAW — that is a supply chain, not a dependency.

The note's own pinned sense refutes the instance claim: it pins the noise floor as 'the baseline LEVEL of background noise' — a level, not a signal. noise's accepted definition carves 'unwanted, unstructured, or interfering SIGNALS that degrade the quality of a desired signal' — the interference itself. noise-floor's accepted definition carves 'a human-made reference LEVEL representing the aggregate of all unwanted background signals ... establishing the threshold': a point on a scale at which those signals sit. A level that describes noise is a property of the system's noise, not an instance of noise. The appeal that 'a competent speaker calls a noise floor a noise' is exactly the generic language appeal Laws 2b/8b refuse, and is false anyway — engineers call it a level, a threshold, a floor. The relation, if any, is that the noise floor measures the system's noise; it is not a kind of it. STRIKE.

measurement's accepted definition (v5) carves 'the ACT of comparing a quantity to a standard unit' — an act, the concrete application of number to the world. bit-depth's accepted definition carves 'a numeric PARAMETER specifying the number of quantization levels ... stored as a fixed metadata field in the audio file format header': a static specification value, set at design time, read back later. You do not perform bit depth; you set it. The note's appeals that it 'quantifies quantization precision' and 'measures resolution' are the generic measurability appeal — any parameter can be said to 'measure' something, and that shows no kind membership. A format parameter is a property of the format, not an instance of the act of measurement. STRIKE.

Use is not purpose. log-sum-exp's accepted definition carves a real-valued function persisting 'as the log-sum-exp trick ... commonly used with c = max(x) to prevent overflow in probability computations', and its scope records it as USED in optimization, machine learning, and probability. The smooth-max property is a mathematical property of the function, not a design decision made for the sake of optimization; the identical trick is load-bearing in probability computation where optimization plays no role. The filer's paired filing — SERVES→optimization and SERVES→statistics with symmetric 'built and maintained for the sake of X' notes — shows there is no unique master: a servant built for the sake of one beneficiary cannot also be built for the sake of the other. Its family relations are already correctly carved (INSTANCE_OF numerical-method, DEPENDS_ON logarithm, both ACCEPTED). Optimization is one of several consumers, not the master for whose sake the function was built. STRIKE.

The accepted definition's own purpose clause refutes the pinned sense: 'Its purpose is to serve as the fundamental building block for IIR filter implementation' — IIR implementation in DSP systems, not audio processing in particular. The note claims the biquad is 'designed and parameterized specifically' for audio signal chains, but the same difference equation runs in telecom equalization and control systems; audio is the dominant application domain, not the built-for purpose. The beneficiary the definition actually names already has its edge drawn: biquad-filter INSTANCE_OF iir-filter is ACCEPTED, with iir-filter and signal-processing the true family. A SERVES arrow to an application domain — a CONCEPT map of operations, not a beneficiary — layered over the accepted family edge is a redundant use-claim dressed as purpose. STRIKE.

Judged against the target's accepted definition (L11d), that definition carves an explicit boundary: 'Distinguished from stereo (which uses fixed channel pairs) by its multidimensional spatial model and ability to place sources at arbitrary positions in 3D space.' A definitional 'distinguished from' clause marks the named thing as OUTSIDE the carve, not as a degenerate subtype — had the author meant stereo to sit inside, the text would say 'generalizes fixed-channel stereo' or 'includes it as a special case'. Stereo also fails the carved parameters: none of the enumerated spatial models (binaural HRTF, ambisonic, matrix surround 5.1/7.1, object-based) is fixed two-channel, and none of the enumerated rendering methods (HRTF convolution, vector-based panning, wave-field synthesis, parametric decoding) applies to fixed channel pairs. The note's appeal to the binaural model list conflates binaural rendering (HRTF-based, headphone-bound) with stereophonic reproduction (fixed channel pairs, speaker-bound) — precisely what the distinguishing clause separates. In audio practice stereophony is the baseline spatial audio is contrasted with. The two are sibling techniques under audio-processing, not specific and general. STRIKE.
